verdicts.reasoning: (a) 我抽到了 HBR《Breakthrough Ideas for 2004》条目 5「The Law of Conservation of Attractive Profits」Christensen 本人稿原文:“Translated into managerial terms, the law goes something like this: When attractive profits disappear at one stage in the value chain because a product becomes modular and commoditized, the opportunity to earn attractive profits with proprietary products will usually emerge at an adjacent stage. If that's the case (and I hasten to add that it's still a hypothesis)...”。待核句比原文少了 “modular and”;而待核句的逐字形态(“becomes commoditized ... usually emerges”)其实是 HBR 编辑在期刊目录页写的摘要(“Clayton M. Christensen explains the law of conservation of attractive profits: When attractive profits disappear ... because a product becomes commoditized ... usually emerges at an adjacent stage”),被 John D. Cook 等博客广泛当作 Christensen 原话转引。此外原文自称“way too simplistically as a result of space constraints”,并明说“it's still a hypothesis”;“conservation of attractive profits”这个名字是他朋友 Chris Rowen(Tensilica CEO)提议的,不是 Christensen 自创。《Innovator's Solution》书中版本为“when modularity and commoditization cause attractive profits to disappear ... will usually emerge at an adjacent stage”(二手转引,书原文未直接打开)。(b) 与 Christensen Institute、Rough Type、Stratechery《Frontier Overhangs》三处逐字一致:“When there is a performance gap ... companies must compete by making the best possible products. In the race to do this, firms that build their products around proprietary, interdependent architectures enjoy an important competitive advantage against competitors whose product architectures are modular, because the standardization inherent in modularity takes too many degrees of design freedom away from engineers, and they cannot optimize performance.” 出自第 5 章 figure 5-1 左侧论述。(c) Christensen Institute 逐字引书:“As this happens, companies that position themselves at a spot in the value chain where performance is not yet good enough will capture the profit.” 该句前文是 “reciprocality of these processes means that the locus of the ability to differentiate shifts continuously...”,与待核句一致。(d) HBR 页面:作者 Clayton M. Christensen, Michael E. Raynor, Matthew Verlinden;“From the Magazine (November 2001)”;摘要逐字 “It owned 70% of the entire mainframe market, controlled 95% of its profits”(注意这是 HBR 页面摘要的写法,70%/95% 指 IBM 在早 1980 年代、外包 OS 与芯片时的份额与利润占比)。
caliber_fixes: (a) 修正前:引语为 '...because a product becomes commoditized ... usually emerges at an adjacent stage' 并归于 Christensen 2004 HBR 文章 → 修正后:若逐字引 Christensen 本人稿,须写 'because a product becomes modular and commoditized ... will usually emerge at an adjacent stage',出处为 HBR 2004-02《Breakthrough Ideas for 2004》条目 5(Christensen 供稿的一页短文);不带 'modular and' 的版本是 HBR 编辑的目录摘要,不得标为 Christensen 原话
(a) 补限定语:Christensen 在同文中自称是 'still a hypothesis' 且 '(way too) simplistically',文章不能把它写成已证定律;名称 'law of conservation of attractive profits' 由 Chris Rowen 提议
(a) 不得写成「利润守恒定律在 2004 年首次提出」于《Innovator's Solution》之外:同文说 'In my recent book—and in an earlier HBR article—I explored a couple of linked ideas',即思想早已见于 2003 年书与 2001 年 HBR 文
(b) HOLDS:逐字无误,出处《The Innovator's Solution》(2003)第 5 章,按原强度可用;注意限定语 'when there is a performance gap',适用前提是性能还不够好
(c) HOLDS:逐字无误(经 Christensen Institute 引书);书原版未直接打开,属二手逐字转引,但与多处一致
(d) HOLDS:作者、刊期(HBR 2001-11)、70%/95% 逐字对;注意 95% 是「利润」占比、70% 是「大型机市场」份额,不是整个计算机行业
verdicts.corrected_statement: Christensen 在 HBR 2004 年 2 月《Breakthrough Ideas for 2004》中写道(自称“still a hypothesis”):“When attractive profits disappear at one stage in the value chain because a product becomes modular and commoditized, the opportunity to earn attractive profits with proprietary products will usually emerge at an adjacent stage.”(“利润守恒”一名由 Chris Rowen 提议)。《The Innovator's Solution》(2003):性能不够好时,'firms that build their products around proprietary, interdependent architectures enjoy an important competitive advantage against competitors whose product architectures are modular';且 'companies that position themselves at a spot in the value chain where performance is not yet good enough will capture the profit'。《Skate to Where the Money Will Be》(Christensen, Raynor, Verlinden,HBR 2001 年 11 月)摘要:IBM 'owned 70% of the entire mainframe market, controlled 95% of its profits'。

verdicts.reasoning: (a) 《Agents Over Bubbles》页面日期 Monday, March 16, 2026。逐字:“profits flow away from modular parts of the value chain — which are commoditized — and flow towards integrated parts of the value chain, which are differentiated.” 随后:“if agents require integration between model and harness, that the companies building that integration — specifically Anthropic and OpenAI (Gemini is a strong model, but Google hasn't yet shipped a compelling harness) — are actually poised to be significantly more profitable than it might have seemed as recently as late last year.” 论断成立,但限定语是“若 agent 需要模型与 harness 的整合”,且只点名 Anthropic/OpenAI,不含 Google;是预测(“poised to be”),非已实现利润。且他 2026-09-21 自己又承认 Microsoft 让 Copilot Cowork 可换模型,模型与 harness 可分离——对 (a) 的整合论是部分反向证据。(b) 《Anthropic's Safety Superpower》页面日期 Monday, June 15, 2026。逐字:“For the first few years of AI the most economic value has flown to compute, for obvious reasons: we don't have enough supply to meet demand, which has meant skyrocketing prices; the biggest beneficiaries have been Nvidia, TSMC, and the memory makers (SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron). Anthropic and OpenAI, meanwhile, have collectively lost tens of billions of dollars building leading-edge models that, once released, are distilled and commoditized by open source models, primarily from China. This represents the bear case for the labs — they never cover their costs because their differentiation is fleeting, while free alternatives become “good enough” — and I think it's a legitimate one. A world where models are interchangeable is one where models are commodities, while most of the value flows elsewhere. Right now that's compute, but in the fullness of time, whenever we have enough compute, the most valuable place to be in the value chain will be the place that has always been the most valuable: owning the user touchpoint.” 两句引语逐字无误。但 “lost tens of billions” 是 Thompson 自己的陈述性事实(无引注),随后他把整段定性为“bear case for the labs”并说“I think it's a legitimate one”——不是单纯转述别人,也不是他的最终结论:他的结论是“A world where models are interchangeable ...”(条件句),并且整篇主旨是实验室有 'economic imperative' 去占用户触点,即反制该熊案。“distilled and commoditized by open source models”是他对机制的断言,无数据。(c) 《Frontier Overhangs》页面日期 Monday, September 21, 2026。逐字:“it does, however, suggest that current model capabilities are “good enough” for customers to not do whatever is necessary to get access to the cutting edge, which reduces the value of the cutting edge to its proprietors, and gives credence to the strategy of Microsoft and others focused on separating harness and model. Pure capability no longer translates directly into a moat.” 待核句引号与省略基本忠实(原文 “good enough” 是双引号,省略号处删了“which reduces the value...”从句)。关键语境:该结论的证据是客户因数据保留政策而改选模型(“customers demonstrated the willingness to base their model-choice decision on something other than pure performance, namely, data retention policies”),且前一句明说“This doesn't, in and of itself, suggest that new model capabilities aren't desired”——是单一事件推论,不是全面结论;且他同文称 Anthropic/OpenAI 应多造有护城河的产品。Copilot Cowork 可选模型:原文“sure enough you can now choose a model for Copilot Cowork”,确认。同文逐字引了 Nadella 在 Stratechery 访谈中说 Copilot 是 multi-model harness。(d) 《Aggregation Theory》页面日期 Tuesday, July 21, 2015,核心表述逐字:“The value chain for any given consumer market is divided into three parts: suppliers, distributors, and consumers/users. The best way to make outsize profits in any of these markets is to either gain a horizontal monopoly in one of the three parts or to integrate two of the parts such that you have a competitive advantage in delivering a vertical solution.” (e) 《The Benefits of Bubbles》页面日期 Wednesday, November 5, 2025。逐字:“Chips break down and get superseded by better ones; most hyperscalers depreciate them over five years, and that may be generous.” 属实;紧接着他的结论是 GPU 支出“might turn out to be a disappointing one”,但随后 “there are two big areas” 抵消(按全文读)。光纤:“That fiber, however, became the background of today's Internet; the fact that it basically existed for free — because the companies who built it went bankrupt — enabled the effectively free nature of the Internet today.” 属实,原文说“basically existed for free”与“effectively free nature of the Internet”,待核句“近乎免费成就了今天的互联网”基本忠实,但须注意他是在说 telecom 债务型建设者破产、“in the best case”。
caliber_fixes: (a) HOLDS 逐字;补限定:是预测('poised to be significantly more profitable than it might have seemed as recently as late last year'),前提是 'if agents require integration between model and harness',只点名 Anthropic 和 OpenAI;不要写成已发生的利润

verdicts.reasoning: (a) HBR Store 页给出 Breakthrough Ideas for 2004,出版日 2004-02-01,作者列表含 Clayton M. Christensen,并逐字载有 'When attractive profits disappear at one stage in the value chain because a product becomes commoditized, the opportunity to earn attractive profits with proprietary products usually emerges at an adjacent stage.' 与论断一字不差。注意它是 HBR 年度清单里的一条短文(合刊多位作者),不是 Christensen 独立长文;条目标题为 The Law of Conservation of Attractive Profits(搜索结果),我未能打开条目全文,只读到 abstract 页引文。(b) 我从 Thompson 2026-09-21 Frontier Overhangs 的 curl 原文读到他引用 The Innovator's Solution(图 5-1 讨论):'firms that build their products around proprietary, interdependent architectures enjoy an important competitive advantage against competitors whose product architectures are modular, because the standardization inherent in modularity takes too many degrees of design freedom away from engineers...' 措辞与论断(b)一致,但是经 Thompson 转引,我没拿到书的扫描页;前置条件原文是 'when there is a performance gap — when product functionality and reliability are not yet good enough to address the needs of customers in a given tier of the market'。(c) 论断 (c) 的句子来自 Derek Sivers 的读书笔记页(sive.rs),该页 CHAPTER 6 一节是他自己的速记体(同页还有 'Wayne Gretzky slogan : don't go where...' 这类缩写句式),不是 Christensen 原文。搜索得到的书中真实表述更接近:'companies will prosper when they are integrated across interfaces in the value chain where performance ... is not good enough'(第6章)以及 'The power to capture attractive profits will shift to those activities in the value chain where the immediate customer is not yet satisfied with the performance of available products.'(后一句的字面我只在搜索摘要中见到,未核到书页)。(d) HBR 官网文章页 curl 原文:'When IBM decided to outsource its operating system and processor chips in the early 1980s, it was, or appeared to be, at the top of its game. It owned 70% of the entire mainframe market, controlled 95% of its profits, and had long dominated the industry.' 作者 Clayton M. Christensen, Michael E. Raynor and Matthew Verlinden,From the Magazine (November 2001),与论断一致。口径提示:70%/95% 是『早 1980 年代的大型机(mainframe)市场及其利润』,不是整个计算机行业;并且 HBR 原话是 'owned 70%... controlled 95% of its profits'。
caliber_fixes: (a) 保留逐字引文,但出处写作『Christensen,《Breakthrough Ideas for 2004》(HBR,2004-02)条目 The Law of Conservation of Attractive Profits』,别写成独立长文;原句只说 proprietary products 在『相邻环节』出现机会,并未说『整合者』——Thompson 的『利润归整合环节』是他对该框架的转述,不要混为 Christensen 原话

(c) 判死『逐字引文』:'companies that position themselves at a spot in the value chain where performance is not yet good enough will capture the profit' 来自 Sivers 的读书笔记而非 Christensen 原文,不得加引号归于书。改为转述:『Christensen 主张,利润会流向价值链中客户尚未对性能满意(not good enough)的环节;在整合跨性能瓶颈接口的公司那里捕获』,或改用已核引文 (b)

verdicts.reasoning: I fetched the article with curl. It is dated 2025-11-28, and all four claims are in the free section; the paywall starts at the later 'what this means for Nvidia' part, so nothing here needs a paywall caveat. (a) Verbatim: "From Google's perspective this results in the all-in TCO per Ironwood chip for the full 3D Torus configuration being ~44% lower than the TCO of a GB200 server... This is from the perspective of Google and the price they procure TPU servers at. Source: SemiAnalysis AI TCO Model". External customers who lease through GCP and pay Google's margin are given a separate number: "the TCO per hour can still be up to ~30% lower than the cost of the GB200 and ~41% lower than the cost of the GB300". (b) Verbatim: "OpenAI hasn't even deployed TPUs yet and they've already saved ~30% on their entire lab wide NVIDIA fleet." A summary passage elsewhere reads "getting ~30% off their compute fleet due to competitive threats". This is SemiAnalysis's inference from its TCO model; no disclosure from NVIDIA or OpenAI is cited. (c) Verbatim: "We think a more realistic explanation is that Nvidia aims to protect its dominant position at the foundation labs by offering equity investment rather than cutting prices, which would lower Gross margins and cause widespread investor panic." It is framed as 'we think', i.e. SemiAnalysis's interpretation. The same article reproduces a response memo from NVIDIA's finance team (from Bernstein) rebutting the circular-financing critique. (d) Verbatim: "The first phase of the deal covers 400k TPUv7 Ironwoods, worth ~$10 billion in finished racks that Broadcom will sell directly to Anthropic... The remaining 600k TPUv7 units will be rented through GCP in a deal we estimate at $42 billion of RPO". This is a SemiAnalysis estimate; neither Google nor Anthropic has disclosed the split. Counter-evidence: on 2025-11-25 NVIDIA said publicly that "Nvidia is a generation ahead of the industry" and that it offers "greater performance, versatility, and fungibility than ASICs" (CNBC and others). I found no independent public TCO number from another firm that directly contradicts the 44%. The 44% depends entirely on SemiAnalysis's assumptions about Google's procurement prices and does not apply to external customers. Also note SemiAnalysis's own interest position: it sells the TCO model the estimates come from.
